question: What is the meaning of or disposal at end-of-life in relation to treatment facilities information?
description: The meaning of disposal at end-of-life in relation to treatment facilities information refers to the process of sorting, collecting, and treating objects when they reach the end of their useful life. This includes activities such as recycling, reusing components or products, and ensuring proper waste management in accordance with environmental regulations and sustainability practices.
